description: CREATES a fake-text video: a phone chat conversation that types itself out over a gameplay or green-screen background, every line read aloud in the voice you pick for that side. YOU WRITE THE SCRIPT: there is no writer behind this endpoint, and the `messages` array you send IS the conversation, in that order, one `{text, from}` per chat bubble (`get_recipe` `fake-text` has the format advice and a worked example). Show it to the user as plain text before spending anything. AFTER: this one call makes the finished video (the answer carries the price split and `renders_automatically: true`; no fire or render step). Wait with `wait_for_generation`; when terminal `get_video` carries the file url. `start_confirmed: false` means the job exists: do not create it again, watch it (`get_recipe` `fake-text`). COST: quoted per character of dialogue, in two parts that are both charged: call `estimate_only: true` first and state `estimated_tokens` (the total). A longer script costs more, AND SO DOES THE VOICE PROVIDER (ElevenLabs is about four times openai per character): change a provider and re-run `estimate_only`; never carry an older quote across that change. NOT OFFERED (say so rather than approximating it): music, chosen gameplay clips, images or sound effects in the chat, contact photos, a second chat, the `cantina` skin. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, state the price in the same message as your ask, wait for a go naming THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).

aspect_ratio.description: Defaults to `9:16`, the vertical shape every short-form platform wants.

background.description: `random` (a gameplay clip, the usual choice) or `greenscreen` (plain, to key out later). Default `random`.

contact_name.description: The name at the top of the phone screen: who the owner is texting ('Mom', 'Jake ❤️').

language.description: The language the conversation is written in, by name ('English', 'German'); default English. Write `messages` in it too: this labels the script, it does not translate it.

messages.description: The conversation, in order, one entry per chat bubble. This is the script, and you write it.

from.description: `right` is the phone's owner (the viewer), `left` is who they text. One speaker, one side.

text.description: One chat bubble. Emoji show but are not spoken, so carry no meaning in them alone.

notification_sounds.description: Play a message tone as each bubble arrives. Defaults to true.

template.description: The chat app skin. Defaults to `imessage`.

voice_left.description: The voice for the LEFT side. The voice id, in the provider named by `voice_provider_*` (omit for its first voice). openai: alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, sage, shimmer, verse (retired `onyx`, `nova`, `fable` still work). elevenlabs: an id from `list_voices` with `provider: 'elevenlabs'` (`usable_for: 'audio', limit: 100`; read `has_more`). Any other id is refused uncharged. Cloned and custom ElevenLabs voices ARE accepted here and on `generate_image_story`; `generate_audio` cannot.

voice_provider_left.description: Who reads the LEFT side. `elevenlabs` is the web app's default, `openai` is cheaper and covers every language with the same eight voices. Defaults to `openai`. IT CHANGES THE PRICE: ElevenLabs costs about four times openai per character, so call `estimate_only` again after changing it.

voice_provider_right.description: Who reads the RIGHT side: same choices and price rule as `voice_provider_left`.

voice_right.description: The voice for the RIGHT side: same rules as `voice_left`.

voice_speed_left.description: The LEFT side's reading speed. 1 normal (default), 1.15 fast, 1.25 very fast. Faster makes the video shorter and costs nothing extra (the price is per character).

voice_speed_right.description: The RIGHT side's reading speed: as `voice_speed_left`.

name: generate_fake_text_video
title: Generate a fake-text chat story video
